findings.claim: The scan CLI prints allowlisted literals verbatim, which can expose PHI or secrets in the scan output.
findings.evidence: The hunk logs `scan-prometheus: allowlisted literal (reviewed): ${literal}`, while `openspec/specs/agent-tooling/karpathy-logging/spec.md` requires scan reports to provide file/line without echoing matched text and the scanner comments state it reports positions only, never matched text.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not print allowlist literal values; report only a count or a stable non-sensitive identifier such as `allowlisted literal #N`.

findings.claim: The new PHI/secret scanner behavior has no accompanying tests in the diff.
findings.evidence: The warning constraint `tests-for-new-features` requires new behaviour to have tests next to the code, and the diff adds scanner implementation files and a `test` script but no `*_test` or `.test.mjs` files covering scan matches, allowlist behavior, binary/oversize fail-closed handling, or non-disclosure of matched text.
findings.suggested_fix: Add Node test files under `.claude/hooks/test/` that exercise `scanText`, `parseAllowlist`, and the CLI output/exit-code behavior.
